Publication Tables

Journal-quality tables: booktabs results with the best value in bold, table notes, merged rows, aligned decimals and long tables.

What it adds

  • Snippet: Results table, best in bold
  • Snippet: Table with notes
  • Snippet: Table with merged rows
  • Snippet: Numbers aligned on the decimal point
  • Snippet: Table across pages

Tags

  • tables
  • booktabs
  • siunitx

Details

  • Version 1.0.0
  • By LatexDo
  • Identifier latexdo.publication-tables

Install Publication Tables

In LatexDo, open the Extensions view, find Publication Tables and choose Install. It is free.
